name: com.infinite-option/builder
title: Infinite Option
description: Manufacturing from CAD files: processes, materials, part templates, links to CAD builder and quote.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Lists what Infinite Option (infinite-option.com, Germany) manufactures from a customer CAD file: processes (3D printing, CNC, sheet metal) with the materials currently offered, accepted file formats, and where to get a price. Read-only.

tools.name: list_part_templates
tools.description: Lists the ready-made parametric parts of the Infinite CAD Builder (a CAD program that runs in the browser), with their adjustable dimensions and a link that opens each part in the builder. Read-only.

tools.name: get_builder_link
tools.description: Returns a link that opens the Infinite CAD Builder in the browser: empty, with a ready-made part (template), with one of its tools, or with a sentence already filled into its "Text zu 3D" input (the user still has to confirm it; nothing is executed by the link). Use at most one of template, tool, text. With template you may add values (dimensions from list_part_templates, within their limits) so the part opens with these dimensions already filled in. Read-only, creates nothing.

template.description: Id of a ready-made part from list_part_templates.

values.description: Only with template: dimensions by parameter key from list_part_templates, e.g. {"module": 2, "teeth": 24} for template gear. Numbers in mm, within the listed limits.

tool.description: handzeichnung = from a hand sketch, ansichten = from drawing views, text = describe in words, volumenkoerper = mesh to solid, foto = from photos.

text.description: German sentence for the "Text zu 3D" input, e.g. "Quader 40 x 20 x 10" or "Bohrung 8 mm, 12 mm tief".

tools.name: get_price_link
tools.description: Returns the link where a customer uploads a CAD file (STEP, STL, 3MF, DXF) to see prices and order online, plus the steps. This server does not calculate prices itself. Read-only.
